description: Moves a phasor's phase forwards or backwards, with the shift optionally snapped to a whole number of steps

params.text: Sets how many equal steps the cycle is divided into, 1 to 64; this is the grid the Quantize switch snaps the shift to
Attenuverter scaling the Steps CV input, with a full 5V sweeping the whole 1 to 64 range
Sets how far the phase is moved, a whole cycle either way at the extremes and no shift at centre
Attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the Shift CV input before it is added to the Shift knob
Truncates the shift to a whole number of steps rather than letting it land anywhere in the cycle

inputs.text: The phasor being shifted, 0-10V; voltages outside that range wrap back into it
Modulates the number of steps, added to the Steps knob
Modulates the shift amount, added to the Shift knob

outputs.text: 10V through the first half of the shifted phasor's cycle and 0V through the second

notes: a phasor drives this, not a clock: a ramp rising from 0V to 10V once per cycle, from Phasor Generator, Clock to Phasor or an LFO's saw output. Nothing moves here until one is patched in.
